verification.scope: Execution and contract checks; business ambiguities require operator answers

notes: Each of the 12 SKUs appears twice: an expired record effective 2026-10-01 and an active record effective 2026-11-01; the operator requires keeping only the active record while retaining its effective_from, so 12 product records should remain after filtering Record state = active.

No effective_to column exists; if the contract needs /prices/*/effective_to it must be derived as (next Valid from - 1 day) for the superseded record, or left null for the active record — this is a derivation choice, not a source value.

Explicit source facts: currency THB on every row, sales unit PCS, price list 'standard', Tax included = 'No' (vat_included false), Tax rate '5%' (0.05) on every row. These are source-stated fixture values and should not be replaced by contract defaults (0.07 VAT) or inferred from country/brand.
SKU values are barcode-like zero-padded codes (00470001...); they must be parsed as text/string, never as integers (the profiler reports them as int min 470001.0).
No pack size, brand, category, barcode, stock/warehouse or promotion columns are present in this table; those target pointers should remain empty rather than fabricated.
Product names ('SIM replenishment N') carry no category or brand meaning; no description column exists.

tables.reason: Header row over 24 data rows = 12 SKUs x 2 price records (one 'expired' dated 2026-10-01, one 'active' dated 2026-11-01). Primary role is pricing; product identity is carried by SKU.

columns.reason: Header 'Product name' with one value per SKU ('SIM replenishment 1'...'12'), no duplicates other than the per-price-record repetition.

columns.name: Currency
columns.reason: Header 'Currency'; single distinct value THB across all 24 rows, an explicit ISO code.

columns.name: Sales unit
columns.reason: Header 'Sales unit'; single value PCS, which matches the target sell-unit enum; no pack size is stated anywhere.

columns.name: Price list
columns.reason: Header 'Price list'; single value 'standard', exactly the contract default and operator's stated price list label.

columns.name: Net price
columns.reason: Header 'Net price', float price-like, 24 distinct values 1134.56-1356.77 with no nulls; one amount per price record.

columns.name: Tax included
columns.reason: Header 'Tax included'; value 'No' for all 24 rows, an explicit boolean source statement that the net price excludes VAT (must be mapped to false, not inferred).

columns.name: Tax rate
columns.reason: Header 'Tax rate'; single fixture value '5%' on every row, a percent-like field that is explicit source evidence of the rate for these price records (5% = 0.05), so the contract default 0.07 must not override it.

columns.name: Valid from
columns.reason: Header 'Valid from'; two ISO dates 2026-10-01 (12 rows) and 2026-11-01 (12 rows), which coincide with the expired/active split, one start date per price record.

columns.name: Record state
columns.reason: Header 'Record state' with exactly two values, 'expired' and 'active', split 12/12 and aligned to the two 'Valid from' dates. It describes the price row, not the product (each SKU has both an expired and an active row), so it cannot populate product-level /status; it is the row filter required by the operator ('export active prices only, exclude expired'). An effective_to for the expired records is derivable from the next row's Valid from (2026-10-31) rather than read from a column.

changes_from_draft: Fixed the collection mapping to use only the DSL keys permitted on /prices (target, source, link, fields, filter, dedupe_keys, normalize_keys) — the previous document carried an invalid extra key on the prices collection.

Added a record-level filter Record state = 'active' and the same filter on the /prices collection, and set dedupe on /sku, so only the active price record per SKU is exported (12 products) while its effective_from (2026-11-01) is retained, per the operator requirement.
Added /prices/*/vat_rate = parse_number_th('Tax rate', percent_to_fraction=true) → 0.05 from the explicit '5%' source value instead of leaving the contract default 0.07.
Changed /prices/*/vat_included from a constant false to parse_bool('Tax included'), which yields false from the explicit source statement 'No' on every row.
Changed /prices/*/price_list from a constant to the source column 'Price list' (value 'standard' on all rows) so the label is read, not assumed.
Added /prices/*/effective_from parsed from 'Valid from' as ISO dates.
Kept /sku as text (trim + cast to string) so the zero-padded codes 00470001-00470012 stay intact; changed the source role to 'pricing'.
Mapped /status from 'Record state' (active→active) rather than leaving it empty; the field describes the retained price row, so confidence is moderate.
effective_to is not present in the source and the retained active record has no end date; it is left unmapped rather than derived or fabricated.
